topics.label: 跨文化接收与价值观契合
topics.query: "cultural transmission" OR "cultural diffusion" OR "cross-cultural reception" OR "intercultural communication" OR "cultural premium" OR novelty OR exoticism OR cosmopolitanism OR (("value congruence" OR "value similarity" OR "shared values") AND (character OR narrative OR audience)) OR (mythology AND analogy)
